quests.instruction: Which routine step fits: "Afternoon to run, jump, and enjoy the fresh air"?
quests.question: Play Outside
quests.hint: A park, backyard, or playground is a perfect spot for this.
quests.explanation: That's right! Playing outside helps our bodies move and stay strong.
quests.funFact: Playing outside is a great way to get exercise while having lots of fun!

quests.instruction: What do we do for this: "Night to sleep cozy and dream beautiful dreams"?
quests.question: Go to Bed
quests.hint: A cozy pillow and a warm blanket are clues for this one.
quests.explanation: Well done! A good night's sleep helps us grow strong and feel happy.
quests.funFact: Sleeping at night gives your busy body time to rest and grow strong!

quests.instruction: Which routine task is done during: "Morning and Night to keep your teeth white and clean"?
quests.question: Brush Teeth
quests.hint: Bubbly white foam and a minty taste are clues for this one.
quests.explanation: Well done! We brush twice a day to keep our teeth sparkling.
quests.funFact: Dentists say we should brush for about two minutes, the same time as a short song!

quests.instruction: Which daily task matches this clue: "Morning to make your way to school before the bell rings"?
quests.question: Walk to School
quests.hint: You use your own two feet for this journey.
quests.explanation: Yes! We walk to school in the morning to get to our classroom.
quests.funFact: Walking to school is a fun way to get a little exercise before class begins!

quests.instruction: Which routine step fits: "Morning to make your hair look neat and tidy for photos"?
quests.question: Comb Hair
quests.hint: You do this after washing your face, before you leave home.
quests.explanation: That's right! Combing our hair smooths out sleepy tangles.
quests.funFact: Some children like fun hairstyles like braids or ponytails after combing their hair!

quests.instruction: What do we do for this: "Morning to put on your clothes before you leave the house"?
quests.question: Get Dressed
quests.hint: This is when pajamas come off and daytime clothes go on.
quests.explanation: Well done! Getting dressed helps us feel ready for school or play.
quests.funFact: Laying out your clothes the night before can make getting dressed super fast in the morning!

quests.instruction: Which routine task is done during: "Evening to put everything back in its proper place"?
quests.question: Tidy Your Room
quests.hint: Clothes, books, and toys all find their spots during this one.
quests.explanation: That's right! Tidying a room means putting everything back in its place.
quests.funFact: A tidy room can help you find your favorite toys much faster the next day!

quests.instruction: Which daily task matches this clue: "Morning to slip these onto your feet before your shoes"?
quests.question: Put on Socks
quests.hint: These go on your feet, right before your shoes.
quests.explanation: Yes! We put on socks to keep our feet warm before our shoes go on.
quests.funFact: Matching two socks together can be a fun little puzzle every morning!

quests.instruction: Which routine step fits: "Evening to arrange forks and napkins before dinner starts"?
quests.question: Set the Table
quests.hint: Plates, cups, and forks are placed down for this one.
quests.explanation: Yes! We set the table before dinner so everyone can sit and eat.
quests.funFact: Helping set the table is a simple way to help your family before a meal!

quests.instruction: What do we do for this: "Morning to open your eyes and start a brand new day"?
quests.question: Wake Up
quests.hint: An alarm clock often helps remind your body it's time for this.
quests.explanation: Well done! Every morning begins the moment we wake up.
quests.funFact: Your body has its own natural clock that helps you wake up at the same time every day!

quests.instruction: Which routine task is done during: "Morning to start the day feeling fresh as can be"?
quests.question: Wash Face
quests.hint: You do this right after you wake up, before you get dressed.
quests.explanation: That's right! Washing our face helps wake up our sleepy eyes.
quests.funFact: Washing your face gently helps keep your skin clean and healthy!

quests.instruction: Which daily task matches this clue: "Morning to get a lunchbox ready before you leave for school"?
quests.question: Pack a Lunch
quests.hint: A lunchbox or paper bag holds the food for this one.
quests.explanation: Yes! We pack a lunch in the morning so we have food ready for midday.
quests.funFact: Some children like to pack their own lunch and choose their favorite foods!

quests.instruction: Which routine step fits: "Afternoon to finish the extra practice your teacher gave you"?
quests.question: Do Homework
quests.hint: This helps you practice what you learned that day in class.
quests.explanation: Well done! Finishing homework helps us feel ready for the next school day.
quests.funFact: Finding a quiet, comfy spot can make homework time easier to focus on!

quests.instruction: What do we do for this: "Evening to gather around the table and share your day"?
quests.question: Eat Dinner
quests.hint: This meal happens after playtime, closer to bedtime.
quests.explanation: That's right! Dinner is the last big meal we share with family.
quests.funFact: Many families enjoy eating dinner together at the very same table each night!

quests.instruction: Which routine task is done during: "Morning to load up your bag with everything you need"?
quests.question: Pack Backpack
quests.hint: Books, pencils, and homework all go inside this one.
quests.explanation: Yes! We pack our backpack in the morning so we're ready for school.
quests.funFact: Packing your backpack the night before can save you time in a busy morning!

quests.instruction: Which daily task matches this clue: "Evening to relax and enjoy a favorite show for a little while"?
quests.question: Watch Some TV
quests.hint: This is a quiet, relaxing activity, done for just a little while.
quests.explanation: That's right! Watching TV for a little while is a fun way to unwind.
quests.funFact: Balancing TV time with playing and reading helps keep your evening varied and fun!

quests.instruction: Which routine step fits: "Morning to greet your family with a cheerful hello"?
quests.question: Say Good Morning
quests.hint: A smile often comes along with these friendly words.
quests.explanation: That's right! Saying good morning is a cheerful way to start the day.
quests.funFact: A cheerful good morning can help set a happy tone for the whole day!

quests.instruction: What do we do for this: "Morning to cover your feet before you head outside"?
quests.question: Put on Shoes
quests.hint: Your feet need this before running, walking, or playing outside.
quests.explanation: Well done! Putting on shoes is one of the last steps before we leave home.
quests.funFact: Velcro shoes were invented to help little hands get ready all by themselves!

quests.instruction: Which routine task is done during: "Midday to sit down and enjoy your favorite lunch"?
quests.question: Eat Lunch
quests.hint: A sandwich, some fruit, or a lunchbox are clues for this one.
quests.explanation: That's right! Lunch gives us energy for the rest of our busy day.
quests.funFact: Lunchtime is a great time to chat and laugh with your friends!

quests.instruction: Which daily task matches this clue: "Anytime to quench your thirst after running and playing"?
quests.question: Drink Water
quests.hint: This helps your body feel cool and full of energy.
quests.explanation: That's right! Drinking water helps us feel refreshed all day long.
quests.funFact: Drinking water instead of sugary drinks is a great habit for a healthy body!

quests.instruction: Which routine step fits: "Night to say a sweet goodbye before everyone falls asleep"?
quests.question: Say Good Night
quests.hint: You say this just before the lights go off.
quests.explanation: Well done! We say good night to the people we love before bedtime.
quests.funFact: Saying good night with a hug or kind words can help you feel calm and happy before sleep!

quests.instruction: What do we do for this: "Night to get comfy right before story time"?
quests.question: Put on Pajamas
quests.hint: You put these on right after your bath.
quests.explanation: That's right! Pajamas are soft, comfy clothes just for sleeping.
quests.funFact: Soft, comfy pajamas can help your body feel relaxed and ready for sleep!

quests.instruction: Which routine task is done during: "Morning to keep your shoes snug with a simple knot"?
quests.question: Tie Shoelaces
quests.hint: Two loops crossed together make the knot for this one.
quests.explanation: Yes! We tie our shoelaces so our shoes stay snug on our feet.
quests.funFact: Some sneakers use velcro instead of laces to make getting dressed even faster!

quests.instruction: Which daily task matches this clue: "Evening to scrub clean from head to toe"?
quests.question: Take a Bath
quests.hint: You do this before you put on your pajamas.
quests.explanation: That's right! A warm bath helps us relax before bedtime.
quests.funFact: Bath time is a great time to sing a silly song while you splash!

quests.instruction: Which routine step fits: "Night to flip the switch before you close your eyes"?
quests.question: Turn Off the Light
quests.hint: This is one of the very last things you do before sleep.
quests.explanation: Well done! A dark, quiet room helps us fall asleep more easily.
quests.funFact: Some children like a soft night light to keep a little glow in the dark!

quests.instruction: What do we do for this: "Morning to wake up your muscles with a big, gentle stretch"?
quests.question: Stretch Your Body
quests.hint: This wakes up muscles that were resting all night.
quests.explanation: That's right! Stretching helps our body feel ready to move after sleeping.
quests.funFact: Stretching gently in the morning can help wake up your whole body!

quests.instruction: Which routine task is done during: "Morning to fill a bowl for your furry friend"?
quests.question: Feed the Pet
quests.hint: You do this for an animal friend at home, not for yourself.
quests.explanation: That's right! Feeding a pet means filling its bowl with food and water.
quests.funFact: Many pets look forward to feeding time as one of the best parts of their day!

quests.instruction: Which daily task matches this clue: "Afternoon to recharge your energy with some quiet sleep"?
quests.question: Take a Nap
quests.hint: A soft blanket and a quiet room help with this one.
quests.explanation: That's right! A short nap helps us feel refreshed for the rest of the day.
quests.funFact: A short nap can help you feel happier and more focused afterward!

quests.instruction: Which routine step fits: "Anytime to scrub away germs with soap and water"?
quests.question: Wash Hands
quests.hint: Soap, water, and a good scrub are clues for this one.
quests.explanation: Yes! We wash our hands to keep sneaky germs away.
quests.funFact: Washing your hands for about twenty seconds is the same as singing a short song!

quests.instruction: What do we do for this: "Morning to sit with classmates on the way to school"?
quests.question: Ride the Bus
quests.hint: A big, often yellow vehicle carries you for this one.
quests.explanation: Yes! We ride the bus in the morning to get to school safely.
quests.funFact: School buses are often painted bright yellow so drivers can spot them easily!
